items.question: In which year did the UAE government launch the Hedayah Centre to counter violent extremism?
items.fact: Hedayah Centre launched in December 2012 to counter violent extremism.

items.question: Under UAE weapons licensing rules, can non-citizens be licensed to possess or carry weapons?
items.gold: No, licensing the possession or carrying of weapons is allowed only for UAE citizens.
items.fact: Weapons possession or carrying licences are only for UAE citizens.
